title: Someone Built Tom Riddle's Diary Using AI

author: Varun Mayya
description:
Try Lovable here: https://lovable.link/4zzDmvc

In this video, we explore how AI coding tools have evolved and what they actually mean for software teams today. Instead of talking about the future in theory, we walk through the internal tools we’ve built at AEOS using Lovable, and where this approach genuinely works today.

We show how we built dashboards to track content performance, onboarding systems for new employees, equipment management tools, internal knowledge bases, and hiring software, all with AI-assisted development. Along the way, we discuss where AI can already replace weeks of development work, where human engineers are still essential, and how teams can think about risk when deciding what to build with these tools.

More than anything, this is a conversation about how software development is changing. We discuss what the role of engineers could look like in the years ahead, why building internal tools has become much easier, and how businesses of every size can use AI
title: 5 Apps I Built With AI to Run My 500-Person Company
